title: Flavonol, Anthocyanin, and Chlorophyll Indices Measurement Protocol
author: David S LeBauer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u6yezfw
materials: See Data Entry documentation for BETYdb

steps.title: Select plants for sampling
steps.instruction: For each two‑row plot, choose replicate plants according to the desired subsampling scheme.

substeps.instruction: For two subsamples per plot: identify 1–3 replicate plants per row (for a standard 3 m row, select the plant nearest 1.5 m from the end).
For six subsamples per plot: identify the centre plant and the two adjacent plants in each of the two rows.

steps.title: Select youngest fully expanded leaf
steps.instruction: On each chosen plant, locate the youngest leaf that is fully expanded; confirm it is fully expanded by checking that it is attached at the ligule and not partially wrapped around the stem.

steps.title: Choose measurement spot on leaf
steps.instruction: On the selected leaf, pick a sunlit area that is approximately horizontal to the ground, roughly halfway between the leaf midrib and the edge, and free of disease or herbivory.

steps.title: Measure with Dualex
steps.instruction: Clip the Dualex Scientific+™ Chlorophyll and Polyphenol‑Meter (model E‑B90‑DUALEX4) onto the chosen leaf spot, then click “OK”; the instrument will automatically record the indices.

steps.title: Record data
steps.instruction: Log the plot name and the measurement number for each reading.
